Subject: Your divorce by mutual consent matter - Petition No. 860/2021

Dear Ms. Khan,

Thank you for meeting us on 10/08/2021 about your dispute with Ishita Gowda. As we understand it, both spouses have lived apart for a long time.

Our advice is to apply to waive the statutory cooling-off period. Please collect proof of separate residence and the consent terms and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹48,90,000.

Regards,
Adv. Tejas Oberoi
